# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 636 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [Etherscan MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/etherscan-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-17): Etherscan's official MCP server for read-only onchain data across EVM chains, such as balances, transactions, token transfers, contracts and logs, usable with or without an API key.
- [CoinMarketCap MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/coinmarketcap-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-17): Official CoinMarketCap MCP server that feeds agents live crypto prices, market caps, rankings and exchange data through your CMC API plan.
- [Stack Overflow MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/stack-overflow-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-17): Official remote MCP server that lets coding agents search and pull vetted Stack Overflow questions and answers, with a free daily call allowance per user.
- [Wolfram MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/wolfram-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-17): Wolfram's official MCP service that gives agents computed answers from Wolfram Language and Wolfram|Alpha, with local, cloud and enterprise deployment options.
- [Paper2Agent](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/paper2agent.html) (added 2026-10-17): Multi-agent system that turns a research paper and its code into a working MCP server and agent skills you can query and run.
- [Agent Memory Leaderboard](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agent-memory-leaderboard.html) (added 2026-10-17): Public leaderboard and open evaluation protocol, run by a group of universities and labs, for comparing long-term memory systems for agents in recurring submission rounds.
- [Craft Agents](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/craft-agents.html) (added 2026-10-17): Desktop app from the makers of Craft for working with agents in a document-first way; the agent sets up APIs and MCP servers for you and sessions can be shared.
- [OpenScience](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/openscience.html) (added 2026-10-17): Research agent workbench that reads the literature, writes and runs code and experiments and logs every step, with skills and connectors for databases like PubMed, UniProt and arXiv.
- [Dograh](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/dograh.html) (added 2026-10-17): Self-hostable voice agent platform with a visual call-flow builder, bring-your-own speech and LLM providers and MCP control, pitched as an open alternative to Vapi and Retell.
- [NitroStack](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/nitrostack.html) (added 2026-10-17): TypeScript framework with decorators and dependency injection for building, testing and deploying MCP servers and MCP apps, with a companion desktop studio.
- [MindsHub](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mindshub.html) (added 2026-10-17): MindsDB's agent workspace for research, analysis, documents and coding, with a model router, a scoped vault for connected data and swappable open-source agent harnesses.
- [MiMo Code](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mimo-code.html) (added 2026-10-17): Xiaomi's terminal coding agent with persistent project memory across sessions; works with any major model provider and is tuned for Xiaomi's MiMo models.
